description.text: Grants [Haste] and [Last Stand], grants [Attach Water] to the user, casts the last ability used by any ally twice, default ability (PHY: single, 1.50 physical)

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%
